resources.string: Get AirBridge ready
Set everything up in one guided go. We\'ll explain each step before it happens.
%1$d of %2$d ready
Everything is set up
AirBridge has every permission it needs.
Review
Here\'s what we\'ll set up
You\'ll see a few pop-ups, then some Android settings pages. On each one, find AirBridge and switch it on. Skip anything you don\'t want. Nothing is turned on that you haven\'t chosen.
Start
Step %1$d of %2$d
Open settings
Skip
What to do
Quick permissions
Phone, contacts, call logs, notifications and nearby devices: for calls, caller names and finding your computer.
Notification access
Shows your phone\'s notifications and calls on your computer.
Tap AirBridge, then switch on notification access.
Notices when a payment app opens, so remote control can pause for it.
Tap AirBridge, then switch on usage access.
Shows the clipboard bubble over other apps.
Tap AirBridge, then switch on “Allow display over other apps”.
Lets your computer turn Do Not Disturb on and off.
Tap AirBridge, then switch on Do Not Disturb access.
Lets your computer\'s brightness keys change this phone\'s brightness.
Tap AirBridge, then switch on “Allow modifying system settings”.
Lets your computer move the pointer, tap and type on this phone.
Tap %1$s, then switch it on. Want to type from your computer? Switch on %2$s as well.
Everything is allowed
Some switches are still off
Continue
Optional
Tap Allow on each pop-up that appears.
Android may not scroll there for you. If you don\'t see it, scroll all the way down to “%1$s” (some phones say “%2$s”) and look for AirBridge.
Installed apps
Downloaded apps
What it\'s for
If you skip it
Calls can\'t be shown or answered on your computer, callers show up without a name, and your computer can\'t find this phone nearby.
Your computer won\'t show this phone\'s notifications, and calls may appear without the caller\'s name.
AirBridge can\'t tell when a banking or payment app is open. Those apps refuse to pay while remote control is running, so your payments could be blocked.
The clipboard bubble can\'t appear, and copied text isn\'t sent to your computer automatically.
Your computer can\'t switch Do Not Disturb on or off for this phone.
Your computer\'s brightness keys won\'t change this phone\'s brightness.
Your computer can\'t move the pointer, tap or type on this phone, so remote control stays off.
Advanced
Tips for phones that keep closing AirBridge in the background
